$Comment:
The Woodcutter's Novice Cap, the graduation piece: the Claim reward on A Finer Edge, the last rung of the sawmill chain, so every player who finishes the chain has one small piece of Woodcutting gear in hand before the chase for the woodcutter's kit begins. It is NOT part of that kit: it sits on the vanilla wooden helm's art (Armor_Wood_Head) rather than the kit's soft leather, so it never reads as the set's missing hood, and its numbers are a first taste rather than a share. It is a standalone copy of that wooden helm: the same icon, model, texture and Physical and Projectile resistances, at Common quality, item level 15 and MaxDurability 120 in place of the vanilla piece's 5 and 60, with its own Health line of 5 against the vanilla helm's 9. No Parent and no Recipe, so no vanilla crafting or salvage recipe can be inherited and the cap stays reward-only. Everything the vanilla helm takes from its own iron parent is spelled out here for the same reason: Categories, the Block animation set, the heavy armour sound set the wooden helm itself sounds with, DurabilityLossOnHit, the Tags, and the Interactions block whose Primary and Secondary each run an EquipItem step. That block is what makes the piece wearable at all, so keep it if you copy this file for a piece of your own.

The stats live in Armor.StatModifiers beside the vanilla Health line and the ENGINE applies them while the cap is worn, exactly as it applies the Health. MMO_BonusXp_WOODCUTTING 3 is plus 3 percent Woodcutting experience and MMO_BonusXp_CRAFTING 3 plus 3 percent Crafting experience, each multiplied into its own skill's awards, sawmill cycles included; MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING 3 is plus 3 percentage points of Woodcutting luck, feeding the MMO's luck ladders and every scored roll this pack ships. Percent-family MMO stats author their PERCENT as the Amount, and every entry is Additive on purpose: these channels carry a base of zero, and additive folds before multiplicative, so a Multiplicative-only entry here would compute zero and be silently inert.

All amounts are opening balance and tunable without an engine change; keep them under the kit's own hood if the cap is to stay the lesser head piece.
